seo.title: 60 Portfolio Project Ideas for Solidity Developers
seo.description: 60 actionable portfolio project ideas for Solidity Developers to showcase their skills and land their next Web3 job.

content.intro: Building a strong portfolio is essential for Solidity developers looking to break into Web3 or level up their careers. These 60 project ideas range from beginner-friendly exercises to advanced protocol implementations, each designed to demonstrate specific skills that hiring managers look for.

sections.heading: DeFi Protocol Implementations
sections.description: Build your own versions of popular DeFi protocols to demonstrate deep understanding of financial primitives.

items.title: Simple AMM (Automated Market Maker)
items.description: Implement a Uniswap V2-style constant product AMM with add/remove liquidity and swap functions. Focus on proper math for pricing and slippage protection.

items.title: Lending Protocol with Liquidations
items.description: Create a basic lending protocol supporting collateralized borrowing with health factor calculations and liquidation mechanics.

items.title: Yield Aggregator Vault
items.description: Build an ERC-4626 compliant vault that auto-compounds yield from a strategy. Great for demonstrating composability.

items.title: Flash Loan Provider
items.description: Implement flash loan functionality similar to Aave. Include callback verification and fee collection.

items.title: Stablecoin with Collateral
items.description: Create a DAI-like overcollateralized stablecoin with minting, burning, and liquidation mechanisms.

items.title: Options Protocol
items.description: Build a simple covered call or put options system with strike prices and expiration handling.

items.title: Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool
items.description: Implement a Balancer-style LBP for fair token launches with time-weighted price curves.

items.title: Perpetual Futures Exchange
items.description: Create a basic perps exchange with funding rates, margin, and position management.

items.title: Bonding Curve Token
items.description: Implement various bonding curve types (linear, exponential, sigmoid) for token price discovery.

items.title: Insurance Pool
items.description: Build a decentralized insurance protocol with premium calculations and claims processing.

items.title: Prediction Market
items.description: Create a binary prediction market with outcome tokens and resolution mechanisms.

items.title: Staking Rewards Contract
items.description: Implement a staking contract with time-weighted rewards distribution similar to Synthetix.

items.title: Token Vesting Contract
items.description: Build a vesting contract with cliff periods, linear unlock, and revocation capabilities.

items.title: Fee Distributor
items.description: Create a protocol fee distribution system that rewards token holders proportionally.

items.title: Concentrated Liquidity AMM
items.description: Implement Uniswap V3-style concentrated liquidity with tick-based position management.

sections.heading: Security & Access Control
sections.description: Projects that demonstrate security best practices and access control patterns.

items.title: Multi-Signature Wallet
items.description: Build a Gnosis Safe-style multisig with configurable thresholds and transaction queuing.

items.title: Time-Locked Admin Controller
items.description: Implement a timelock contract for governance actions with delay and cancellation.

items.title: Upgradeable Proxy Pattern
items.description: Create a UUPS or Transparent proxy implementation with proper initialization guards.

items.title: Access Control Registry
items.description: Build a role-based access control system with hierarchical permissions.

items.title: Emergency Circuit Breaker
items.description: Implement a pausable contract pattern with guardian roles and automatic triggers.

items.title: Signature Verification System
items.description: Create EIP-712 typed data signing and verification for gasless transactions.

items.title: Rate Limiter Contract
items.description: Build a rate limiting system to prevent spam or manipulation attacks.

items.title: Merkle Tree Allowlist
items.description: Implement Merkle proof verification for efficient allowlist management.

items.title: Commit-Reveal Scheme
items.description: Create a commit-reveal pattern for fair randomness or auction bidding.

items.title: Reentrancy Guard Implementation
items.description: Build various reentrancy protection patterns and demonstrate their effectiveness.

items.title: Social Recovery Wallet
items.description: Implement a wallet with guardian-based recovery mechanisms.

items.title: Diamond Pattern (EIP-2535)
items.description: Create a modular contract using the Diamond standard for upgradeable facets.

items.title: Gas Optimized Batch Processor
items.description: Build a contract that efficiently processes batched operations with gas refunds.

items.title: Minimal Proxy Factory
items.description: Implement EIP-1167 clone factory for gas-efficient contract deployment.

items.title: Account Abstraction Wallet
items.description: Build an ERC-4337 compatible smart contract wallet with custom validation.

sections.heading: NFT & Gaming Projects
sections.description: Creative NFT implementations and on-chain gaming mechanics.

items.title: Dynamic NFT with On-Chain Metadata
items.description: Create an NFT that stores and renders SVG metadata entirely on-chain.

items.title: NFT Staking with Rewards
items.description: Build an NFT staking system that rewards holders with ERC-20 tokens.

items.title: NFT Marketplace
items.description: Implement a basic marketplace with listings, auctions, and royalty payments.

items.title: Soulbound Token (SBT)
items.description: Create non-transferable tokens for credentials or reputation.

items.title: NFT Lending Protocol
items.description: Build a peer-to-peer NFT lending system with collateral management.

items.title: On-Chain Game: Rock Paper Scissors
items.description: Implement RPS with commit-reveal for fairness and betting mechanics.

items.title: NFT Fractionalizer
items.description: Create a contract that splits NFT ownership into fungible ERC-20 tokens.

items.title: On-Chain Lottery
items.description: Build a lottery with VRF integration for provably fair randomness.

items.title: ERC-1155 Multi-Token System
items.description: Implement a game inventory system using ERC-1155 for efficient batch transfers.

items.title: NFT Royalty Splitter
items.description: Create an EIP-2981 compliant royalty distribution system.

items.title: Generative Art NFT
items.description: Build NFTs with on-chain generative art using pseudo-random seed values.

items.title: NFT Dutch Auction
items.description: Implement a descending price auction mechanism for NFT minting.

items.title: On-Chain Achievement System
items.description: Create a badge/achievement NFT system based on on-chain activities.

items.title: NFT Rental Protocol
items.description: Build ERC-4907 compliant NFT rentals with time-limited access.

items.title: Composable NFTs
items.description: Implement ERC-998 for NFTs that can own other tokens.

sections.heading: DAO & Governance
sections.description: Governance mechanisms and decentralized organization tooling.

items.title: Governor Contract
items.description: Build an OpenZeppelin Governor-compatible governance system with voting.

items.title: Token-Weighted Voting
items.description: Implement vote delegation and snapshot-based voting power calculation.

items.title: DAO Treasury Manager
items.description: Create a treasury contract with proposal-based spending and diversification.

items.title: Quadratic Voting System
items.description: Implement quadratic voting for more democratic decision-making.

items.title: Conviction Voting
items.description: Build continuous voting where conviction builds over time.

items.title: Rage Quit Mechanism
items.description: Implement Moloch-style rage quit for fair exit from DAOs.

items.title: Grants Program Contract
items.description: Create a milestone-based grants distribution system.

items.title: Optimistic Governance
items.description: Build an optimistic execution system with veto periods.

items.title: Reputation-Based Voting
items.description: Implement non-transferable reputation tokens for governance weight.

items.title: DAO Membership NFT
items.description: Create membership NFTs with tiered access and benefits.

items.title: Streaming Payments
items.description: Build Sablier-style token streaming for continuous payments.

items.title: Bounty Board Contract
items.description: Create a decentralized bounty system with submissions and approvals.

items.title: Vote Escrow Token
items.description: Implement Curve-style veTokens with time-locked voting power.

items.title: Sub-DAO Factory
items.description: Build a factory for creating and managing sub-DAOs within a parent DAO.

items.title: Proposal Builder
items.description: Create a contract for constructing and validating complex governance proposals.

proTips: Always write detailed tests using Foundry's fuzzing capabilities - this demonstrates security awareness that employers value highly.
Document your code with NatSpec comments and create a detailed README explaining architecture decisions and trade-offs.
Deploy your projects to testnets (Sepolia, Goerli) and include verified contract links in your portfolio.
Add a 'Security Considerations' section to each project highlighting potential attack vectors you've mitigated.
Create a GitHub organization for your portfolio projects and maintain consistent code quality across all repos.
